text:
maria: quick check — preparing to onboard model mpt-30b-v2-rl into hosted inference. main blockers: weights location, tokenizer oddness, and final quantization approval (AWQ / GPTQ / FP8). can folks sign off on the checklist?

sam: weights are at s3://redwood-models/onboard/mpt-30b-v2-rl/ (sha: d4c3f2). i pushed a small manifest at `manifests/mpt-30b-v2-rl.json` in the repo.

maria: thanks. sam — can you confirm that the weights bundle includes both fused and split versions? we need the split for GPTQ path.

sam: yep. bundle has `weights/fused/` and `weights/split/`. GPTQ recipe points to `weights/split/`. AWQ uses `weights/fused/` by default.

yoav: note on tokenizer: tokenizer.json has duplicated <|eos|> token entry in the vocab for historical reasons. it causes off-by-one in some decoding loops. tested with a short script: `python tools/check_tokenizer.py --path tokenizer.json` returns a warning.

lee: that duplication will break prefix caching in the serving runtime. do we have a sanitized tokenizer file?

sam: i created `tokenizer.sanitized.json` in the same s3 path. script output now clean. will open a PR to update model manifest to point at sanitized file. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/452

maria: perfect. next — calibration dataset. we plan to use 8k sequences sampled stratified across domain: docs, chat transcripts, code. is that enough for FP8/AWQ?

yoav: for AWQ 8k is OK for 30B but ensure we include long-tail tokens. add ~1k low-frequency samples. for FP8 i'd prefer 12k because dynamic range estimation is noisier.

sam: adding 2k low-freq samples now. new size 10k. i'll upload `calib/calib_samples_10k.jsonl`.

lee: calibration seeds? reproducibility matters — please pin RNG and list sampling query IDs in the manifest.

sam: done — added `calib/seed=20260310` and `calib/ids.txt` to the s3 path.

maria: great. accuracy tradeoff: product asked for <= 1% relative drop in MMLU / coding eval vs fp32 baseline. can we achieve that with AWQ? GPTQ? FP8?

yoav: AWQ should be within ~0.5% on MMLU for this arch if we tune per-channel scales. GPTQ may need layerwise tuning; expect 0.5–1.5% depending on blocking. FP8 is risky — likely >2% unless we do per-tensor bias correction.

lee: ops preference is AWQ for latency/cost. if AWQ fails post-calib we can fall back to GPTQ on dedicated pools. need a cross-team decision for SLA behavior.

maria: proposal: default to AWQ on hosted; couple a test canary route that uses GPTQ fallback if AWQ produces >1% eval regression in canary window. approve?

sam: :thumbsup: from infra. i can wire an automatic regression check in `redwood-evals` that monitors MMLU and a small code-gen suite during canary.

yoav: +1 but add a manual gate before full promote. automatic alerts only.

lee: noted — ops will create canary rule: runtime fallback to `model: mpt-30b-v2-rl-gptq` after 5 failed eval windows (5m each).

maria: PRs outstanding: model manifest update (sam), quantization recipe (yoav) — please tag reviewers. also need a quick config validation: 1) `max_seq_len` match across manifest/runtime, 2) tokenizer path sanitized, 3) kv-cache enable flag, 4) batch size heuristics. can someone run `scripts/validate_manifest.py`?

sam: running now: `python scripts/validate_manifest.py --manifest manifests/mpt-30b-v2-rl.json`

deploy-bot: validation job queued (job id: 8721).

qa-bot: manifest validation results: 4 checks passed, 1 warning (tokenizer original duplicated entries). sanitized tokenizer in manifest — warning resolved pending PR merge.

sam: manifest lints OK otherwise. posted config snippet in PR.

maria: final ask — could someone from infra or eng-runtime start an AWQ calibration run on a small dedicated node so we can eyeball logits and activations? link to run dashboard when started.

sam: scheduling AWQ calib on `dedicated-quant-03`. estimated ~2h. will post dashboard link.

yoav: i'll watch early outputs. if we see activation spikes, i'll try per-channel clipping.

lee: ops FYI — after AWQ we should run a 1h canary in hosted-us-west with 1% traffic. deploy-bot can you schedule?

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: start 2026-03-10T21:40Z, duration 1h, target 1% traffic, fallback policy configured.

maria: awesome. last: can reviewers please ack in thread once PRs merged so we can flip the switch. thanks all :raised_hands:

sam: ack when PR merged.

yoav: ack after calibration run completes and evals pass.

lee: will monitor the canary. :eyes:
